# Michigan Morel Report

> Tracks how far north Michigan's soil has warmed into the morel window, region by region, against a ten year
> normal. Built and maintained by Chris Izworski in Bay City.

## What makes this different
Morel content online is almost entirely folklore and calendar dates. The actual trigger is soil temperature:
morels fruit when soil at a few inches settles into roughly the low to mid fifties Fahrenheit, a few days after
rain. Michigan runs over four hundred miles south to north, so that trigger arrives about five weeks apart at
the two ends. This site tracks the wave rather than publishing a date.

## Honest limits, stated on the site itself
- Michigan has only about three public soil temperature stations, so soil warming here is MODELLED from air
  temperature using a trailing seven day mean, plus growing degree days base 50F accumulated from March 1,
  compared against a ten year normal. It is timing guidance, not a thermometer reading.
- The model is gated on the calendar (March through June). Without that gate autumn temperatures descending
  through the same band would falsely report a prime window in October.
- It cannot see slope, aspect, canopy, or soil moisture. Indicator plants beat it at local scale.
- It is NOT an identification guide and never says a mushroom is safe to eat. False morels grow in the same
  woods at the same time and some contain gyromitrin.
- It does not publish anybody's spots.

## Pages, all one click from the front page
- [Where the season is](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/)
- [When morels come up](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/when-morels-come-up.html): the trigger and the model
- [False morels](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/false-morels.html): safety
- [Where morels grow](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/where-morels-grow.html): habitat, trees, burns
- [Indicator plants](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/indicator-plants.html): trillium, fiddleheads, lilac
- Regions: [Southern](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/southern-michigan.html),
  [Central](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/central-michigan.html),
  [Northern Lower](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/northern-lower.html),
  [Eastern UP](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/eastern-up.html),
  [Western UP](https://morel.chrisizworski.com/western-up.html)

## Data
Applied Climate Information System (ACIS), aggregating NOAA and NWS station records. Michigan DNR for land
rules. Michigan Mushroom Hunters Club for identification learning.
